anatomy.flutter: Checkbox (StatefulWidget) wraps a SelectionControl (the box: fill/border/shadow/focus-ring socket) whose child is either SizedBox.shrink() (unchecked) or a KeyedSubtree(_Mark) drawing _tickPath()/_dashPath() via CustomPaint, matching checkbox.tsx's own CheckboxPrimitive.Root + CheckboxPrimitive.Indicator + two <svg> mark variants.
anatomy.web: CheckboxPrimitive.Root (Radix) with checkboxControlClassName styling, containing CheckboxPrimitive.Indicator > two conditionally-shown blocks (tick vs indeterminate dash), toggled by group-data-[state=indeterminate]/checkbox:hidden / :block.

api.flutter: Checkbox({state: CheckboxState.unchecked|checked|indeterminate, onChanged, enabled, disabledReason, inert, invalid, forceFocusRing, focusNode, label, hint}) -- CheckboxState.nextAfter(state) mirrors Radix's toggle rule (anything not checked becomes checked).
api.web: CheckboxPrimitive.Root's checked: boolean | "indeterminate", onCheckedChange, disabled, required, name, value props passed straight through (...props) with the two-svg CheckboxMark for the visual.

states.flutter: CheckboxState enum (unchecked/checked/indeterminate) drives SelectionControl fill/border/shadow (theme.primary+Shadows.controlPrimary when isOn vs theme.card+Shadows.inset), and _reveal (re-keyed KeyedSubtree) forces every transition into a lit state to redraw its mark from a fresh dash offset -- documented as matching a measured browser behaviour where a hidden mark holds no live CSS animation and remounting restarts it from zero, correcting an earlier IndexedStack-based model that got this wrong.
states.web: data-state="unchecked"|"checked"|"indeterminate" drives data-[state=checked]/data-[state=indeterminate] bg-primary/border-primary/shadow-btn-primary classes; the shared `anim-change` squash-and-settle plays on the two <path>s, remounted via the group-data-[state=indeterminate]/checkbox:hidden toggle exactly as the Flutter doc comment describes.

disabled.flutter: enabled (ANDed with FieldScope's), disabled dims via SelectionControl's own disabled skin and reads disabledReason ?? scope?.disabledReason as an explanatory tooltip; separately, `inert` models a controlled-but-handlerless checkbox that stays opaque/focusable/announced-enabled per Radix's own controlled behaviour, distinct from `enabled: false`.
disabled.web: disabled prop (via CheckboxPrimitive.Root) triggers disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 and group-has-disabled/field:opacity-50; a controlled checked prop with no onCheckedChange handler is Radix's native 'inert' case, reproduced faithfully on the Flutter side including the drift the doc comment names (disabled: false, opacity 1).

interaction.flutter: onTap wired through SelectionControl to toggle (enabled && !inert && onChanged != null); a FieldScope's label activator (`<label for>` equivalent) is registered so tapping a FieldLabel ticks the box, and is explicitly withheld when inert (matching Radix: a controlled checkbox with no handler is not toggled by its label either).
interaction.web: Native <button role="checkbox"> (Radix) handles pointer/keyboard (Space) activation and focus-visible ring; a <label> wrapping the control natively activates it via the DOM label-for-control association.

semantics.flutter: Semantics(container: true, checked: state==checked, mixed: state==indeterminate, enabled: enabled && (inert || onChanged != null), label, hint) placed inside the hit-area expander, matching Radix's own aria-checked="true"|"false"|"mixed" and its disabled attribute semantics including the inert drift.
semantics.web: Radix CheckboxPrimitive.Root renders role="checkbox" aria-checked="true"|"false"|"mixed" and native disabled attribute handling; the after:-inset-x-3 after:-inset-y-2 pseudo-element grows the 20px hit target to a documented 42×34 area without changing the visible box, matching Flutter's HitArea/SelectionControl target-size handling.
